integrity: Analytic proof from Fock-basis twirl selection, residue-block QFI bounds, the central-binomial asymptotic, and Stirling's formula. Primary source is an arXiv preprint first posted 2026-10-02.
scientific_limitations: Ideal single-mode phase twirling only; no optical loss or thermal noise.
Comparison is between mean-one squeezed vacuum and the coherent state of amplitude one, not all possible probes or all phase-covariant classical protocols.
The ratio is asymptotic along odd M tending to infinity; no exact finite-M ratio or independent audit is claimed.
title: Odd-Cardinality Phase Twirling Preserves a Super-Exponential Squeezed-Light Advantage
